diagnosis: The financial transaction streaming namespace permits sockets to subscribe to real-time payment events across the Redis cluster solely based on the namespace path without validating that socket.data.user.tenantId matches the target tenantId in the namespace. An authenticated client can listen to live transaction flows and cardholder payment events belonging to other tenants.
